segments.title: Excel now finds your mess
segments.say: Copilot in Excel can now find the mess in your spreadsheet for you.

segments.title: It looks for
segments.say: Microsoft says the clean data skill scans for duplicates, messy formatting and wrong data types.

segments.title: You approve every fix
segments.say: It suggests fixes right in the file, and you approve every change.
So in a workbook with Copilot, just ask it to check your data.
segments.text: Find duplicates and formatting problems in this sheet.

segments.title: If your work Excel has Copilot
segments.say: It's in Microsoft three sixty five Copilot. Microsoft says it rolled out in October.
Save this, and follow for one AI update a day.
